beforeYouStart.title: Before You Start
beforeYouStart.description: Import a zip archive with Markdown files. LeafWiki first creates a review plan, and only imports pages after you explicitly start the execution step.
beforeYouStart.safeReviewText: Creating the plan does not import pages yet.
beforeYouStart.linksAssetsText: Internal links and embedded assets are rewritten during import.
beforeYouStart.alphaText: Some Markdown variants may still need manual cleanup afterward.

package.title: Choose Import Package
package.description: Select a zip archive that contains Markdown files. After that, we create a preview plan so you can inspect paths, actions, and notes before the import runs.
package.issueHint: If you run into problems, unexpected results, or unsupported edge cases, please create an issue on our <link>GitHub repository</link>.
package.supportedInputHint: Supported input: a single `.zip` archive containing your Markdown knowledge base.
package.planOnlyHint: This only creates the review plan. No pages are imported until you click `Execute Import Plan`.

plan.title: Import Plan
plan.description: Review what LeafWiki is about to create, update, or skip before you start the import.

plan.runningInBackground: The import is running in the background. You can stay on this page to watch progress.
plan.canceledNotice: The import was canceled. Completed items were kept, and the partial result is shown below.

plannedItems.title: Planned Items ({{count}})
plannedItems.description: These are the individual files LeafWiki detected in the package and how they map to target pages.

run.title: Run Import
run.descriptionPlan: Start the import once the plan looks correct. You can also clear the current plan and begin again with a different package.
run.descriptionRunning: The importer is currently working through the generated plan. You can stay on this page to monitor progress or request cancellation.

result.title: Import Result
result.description: This is the final outcome of the import. Skipped items usually need manual review, while failed items need attention before retrying.
result.wantAnotherBody: Start a new import to clear this result and choose a different zip file.
